entries.title: Job 40:2
segments: Will he who is protesting give teaching to the Ruler of all? Let him who has arguments to put forward against God give an answer.

entries.title: Job 40:3
segments: And Job said in answer to the Lord,

entries.title: Job 40:4
segments: Truly, I am of no value; what answer may I give to you? I will put my hand on my mouth.

entries.title: Job 40:5
segments: I have said once, and even twice, what was in my mind, but I will not do so again.

entries.title: Job 40:6
segments: ¶Then the Lord made answer to Job out of the storm-wind, and said,

entries.title: Job 40:7
segments: Get your strength together like a man of war: I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

entries.title: Job 40:8
segments: Will you even make my right of no value? will you say that I am wrong in order to make clear that you are right?

entries.title: Job 40:9
segments: Have you an arm like God? have you a voice of thunder like his?

entries.title: Job 40:10
segments: Put on the ornaments of your pride; be clothed with glory and power:

entries.title: Job 40:11
segments: Let your wrath be overflowing; let your eyes see all the sons of pride, and make them low.

entries.title: Job 40:12
segments: Send destruction on all who are lifted up, pulling down the sinners from their places.

entries.title: Job 40:13
segments: Let them be covered together in the dust; let their faces be dark in the secret place of the underworld.

entries.title: Job 40:14
segments: Then I will give praise to you, saying that your right hand is able to give you salvation.

entries.title: Job 40:15
segments: ¶See now the Great Beast, whom I made, even as I made you; he takes grass for food, like the ox.

entries.title: Job 40:16
segments: His strength is in his body, and his force in the muscles of his stomach.

entries.title: Job 40:17
segments: His tail is curving like a cedar; the muscles of his legs are joined together.

entries.title: Job 40:18
segments: His bones are pipes of brass, his legs are like rods of iron.

entries.title: Job 40:19
segments: He is the chief of the ways of God, made by him for his pleasure.

entries.title: Job 40:20
segments: He takes the produce of the mountains, where all the beasts of the field are at play.

entries.title: Job 40:21
segments: He takes his rest under the trees of the river, and in the pool, under the shade of the water-plants.

entries.title: Job 40:22
segments: He is covered by the branches of the trees; the grasses of the stream are round him.

entries.title: Job 40:23
segments: Truly, if the river is overflowing, it gives him no cause for fear; he has no sense of danger, even if Jordan is rushing against his mouth.

entries.title: Job 40:24
segments: Will anyone take him when he is on the watch, or put metal teeth through his nose?
